title: 17 Accounts and Connections
subtitle: Where am I signed in, in which project, and does the connection work — accounts → projects → three places, seven connection states on one chip, the avatar menu per state, Sync for a local project, Settings as one column of cards (General · Connections · Advanced), one Link your server dialog, and Home with every project's place
brief: Several accounts on cloud.maude.sh, several projects under each. A project is either connected to the person's own local repo, or Maude keeps a copy somewhere in the background. Plus projects on the person's own servers. The person must find their way at a glance: where they are signed in, in which project, and whether the connection works. As simple as possible.
